'''Nim-Sa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he asked [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Jaymis]] to help in dealing with the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].
